issue_context.title: Cannot access a document entry in another locale while having the right permissions to do so
issue_context.body: ### Describe the bug Cannot access a document entry in another locale while having the right permissions to do so - RBAC issue again ### Steps to reproduce the behavior **As an admin** - Create a single type with whatever fields with i18n enable - Save this single type document with random values in 2 locales (English / French) **As an editor** - Open the CREATE (see issue above), READ access to the Single Type you just created for the English local, and only the READ access for French - Go to the CTM, try to switch from one locale to another, you can’t, there is no error display. - Now, give the CREATE access to the French locale and you can switch ### Expected behavior RBAC rules are adhered to and the user can read the FR locale and edit the EN locale. Also worth improving the error messaging on this ### Screenshots See above

review_comments: I'm not sure I understand thise change ? for a single type this will return undefined ? why is it better ?

If you compare to `releases/5` you'll see the logic for the return id here hasn't actually changed 

What we did in `[fix/rbac-locales](https://github.com/strapi/strapi/tree/fix/rbac-locales)` with `const singleTypeId = collectionType === SINGLE_TYPES ? document.document?.documentId : undefined;` was an attempt to fix permissions with single types but we found it had too many side effects

These InputRenderer changes are what we've done instead https://github.com/strapi/strapi/blob/ca278734871c5ea02ab7d1bbe932089ac2bd16be/packages/core/content-manager/admin/src/pages/EditView/components/InputRenderer.tsx#L49-L52
